dct_title_s: North America : Great Bank of Newfoundland with adjacent coast : Cape Bonavista to Cape St. Mary
dct_description_sm: Compiled from the latest information ; ...published Sep. 1887, at the Hydrographic Office under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Depths shown by soundings and spot shading, dotted lines.
Lights table, magnetic variation compass roses (variation in 1910), legends and abbreviations.
Shows low water areas, coasts, drainage, small islands, beacons and lights.
Locations of larger scaled charts underlined.
Hydrographic Office Division of Issue stamp, faded, has date Jun 16 1916.
